implementation: Opt-in contract_group_rotations now offers independent same-face turns of required-top groups over a fixed snapshot of existing face assignments. Connector-connected and through-hole groups remain stationary. Incumbents are preserved; no recursive top-turn expansion. Every candidate uses existing geometry, local contract and fanout qualification. Board-level checks remain authoritative.

tests.coverage: Independent rigid/pad transforms without reflection, unchanged nets/face/mirror and stationary members, face-aware courtyard clearance and bounds, local contracts/fanout, deterministic geometry and operation receipts, mixed top-turn/bottom-group combinations, explicit USB U1 owner rotations, connector anchoring, synthetic top-only group availability and repeated-call idempotence. Existing through-hole and unconnected-pad rejection coverage retained.
tests.scope: Targeted batch, not a new exhaustive 278-test run.

usb_catalog.scope: Orientation fixture including propagated whole-sheet alternatives, not accepted boards or necessarily unique global layouts. Broad offer growth requires further performance evaluation; opt-in only.

normal_path_regressions.scope: Model screens with experimental rotations disabled, both exact released PCB hashes. Executed before final top-only early-return repair, which only unlocks the enabled experiment. Concurrent timings, not controlled benchmarks or full qualification.

experiment.status: RUNNING at checkpoint; no acceptance claimed
experiment.observed: Some attempts reached the legalizer and were rejected by flow_hop power->power_som margin -7.8769; other attempts still failed seating. This is not proof of global infeasibility.
experiment.provenance: Exploratory binary before final top-only early-return repair. Do not present as a qualification of the final binary.

corrections_during_testing: Initial test incorrectly required every top group to have multiple parts; replaced with per-candidate nonempty movement and aggregate multi-part plus explicit USB-core coverage. Synthetic replay test then caught an older bottom-compaction early return that skipped top-only sheets; corrected the control flow without changing hardware rules.
limits: No new smaller board accepted. Published master and release imagery unchanged. Experimental breadth may increase runtime; do not enable by default until quality/cost is demonstrated. Routing and fabrication qualification remain out of scope.
